sources.pageTitle: Due dates & requirements for annual general meetings (AGMs)
sources.selection: From All Singapore companies must hold AGMs each year through What you must do: Hold a general meeting within 14 days of the request. Includes the 31 August 2018 applicability boundary, both general deadlines, both private-company exemption paths, unanimous-member dispensation, member and auditor safeguards, and application-before-due-date EOT evidence.
sources.effectiveDateEvidence: The official page labels the deadline table FY ending on or after 31 August 2018. It says extension applications must be made before the relevant AGM due date; this page does not establish duration or all eligibility conditions.
